sources.snippet: 3.1 Model architecture SmolVLA is composed of two main components: (i) a pretrained VLM tasked with perception and (ii) an action expert, trained to act. The two components are interconnected, as the VLM processes state inputs to generate features that condition the action expert, which produces actions in turn altering the state fed to the VLM.
